explanation: Odysseus had been away for 20 years. Old and neglected, Argos wags his tail and drops his ears at the sight of his master, then dies.

claims.text: In the Odyssey, the dog Argos recognizes Odysseus when he returns home disguised as a beggar.
Cerberus, Laelaps and Orthrus are other dogs of Greek myth, not Odysseus's dog.
Odysseus returns to Ithaca after 20 years away.
Argos, old and neglected, wags his tail and drops his ears when he sees Odysseus, and then dies.
